title: Help us test LEND
description: This study looks at the impact of LEND. We want to hear what worked for you and what didn’t, so that we can make LEND as helpful as possible.

title: Complete our survey
description: We want to find out more about you, your experience of dementia and how you use technology. Your answers will help us create better online support.

title: Share your story
description: Sharing stories can improve quality of life for people affected by dementia. We are looking for people who would like to share their own experience of dementia.

link.label: Find out more about sharing your story

title: Take part in a discrete choice experiment
description: We are running a discrete choice experiment (DCE) to understand people’s preferences for different parts of LEND. This will help us find out which features matter most.
